comparison.objective: Hold an M.2 drive flat while turning its latch, not screen dry solids.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-down plus quarter-turn latch actuation versus load-shared sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Drive flat, latch over its end, and both hands released; no material recovery.
comparison.reason: Both require coordination, but board latching under preload is a different tested ability. Rubric is complete.
